# Why did my Brevo contacts import skip contacts or create odd attributes?

> Free Brevo (Sendinblue) contacts import CSV checker: finds invalid and duplicate emails, rows with neither email nor SMS, SMS numbers with no country code or ruined by Excel, unquoted commas that shift columns, mixed date formats and near-miss column names, with line numbers, and applies formatting-only safe fixes.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
